row.evidence: SS&C Advent's Geneva page offers only 'Request a Demo' and 'Contact us to find out how Geneva can work for you'; no pricing, SSO, SCIM or user-provisioning documentation is public.
row.notes: New row. Advent Geneva is SS&C Advent's portfolio management and fund accounting system for alternative investment managers, sold by quote (demo request only) and run on-premises or hosted through Advent Managed Services. advent.com's sitemap (781 URLs), Geneva product pages and briefs mention 'extensible APIs' and REST APIs for data flow but nothing on SSO, SCIM or user provisioning; product documentation sits behind the Advent Community login (login.advent.com, which itself offers 'Log in using SSO' for the client portal, not Geneva). Okta's catalogue has no Geneva app (only 'Advent Community' SWA and Black Diamond apps), and Entra's SaaS tutorial index has no Geneva entry. Status unknown rather than none because the help centre and product docs are not public.

scim.notes: No public SCIM documentation; Geneva docs are behind the Advent Community login.

limitations.text: Geneva data APIs are described only in marketing material; no public API reference.

user_api.notes: Marketing pages mention 'extensible APIs' and REST APIs for data integration, but no user-management API is documented publicly.

okta.notes: OIN search 'geneva' returns nothing; 'advent' returns Advent Community (SWA, the client portal) and Black Diamond apps (a different SS&C product).

entra.notes: No Geneva or Advent tutorial in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index.

fallbacks.notes: Product documentation is only available through the Advent Community login; Geneva can be self-hosted or hosted via Advent Managed Services.
